note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: At 1:1 the burl mottling is smeared and soft; the knot and pore detail reads as blur rather than crisp burl grain. Colour and blotch layout match the original.
flags.fix: Reduce the up_wrap smoothing or raise mid-frequency lab-inject gain so burl knots and pores are crisp at 1:1; re-check the bands and mip seam after the change.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the cutout edges are feathered and the foliage reads as out of focus, with pale speckle noise from the grain injection instead of leaf structure.
flags.fix: Sharpen the back-projected alpha edge before the colour pass, and lower the lab-inject speckle gain so the foliage shows leaf-cluster structure rather than noise.
